text: 中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》。其中提出，
text_en: The People's Bank of China and eight other departments jointly issued the 'Notice on Strengthening Data Development and Utilization in Sci-Tech Finance.' It proposes improving the data enrichment mechanism for sci-tech enterprises, enhancing credit data interoperability, and promoting the coordinated development and utilization of sci-tech finance data in a broader range and at deeper levels, to better serve the innovation-driven development strategy.
